evals.prompt: Run the Rust quality pipeline on evals/files/demo_crate
evals.expected_output: The three subagent stages run sequentially with their gates enforced between them, ending in one consolidated report of per-stage changes and per-gate PASS/FAIL status.
expectations: The stages run one at a time in the order review, then tests, then doc-comments, with each stage's summary collected before the next stage starts
The matching gate runs after each stage — clippy with warnings denied after review, the test suite after tests, a build after doc-comments — and no later stage starts after a failed gate
A single consolidated report ends the run, with one line per stage (what it changed, or skipped/clean) and a PASS/FAIL status for every gate that ran
Gates and stages that already passed are not re-run

evals.prompt: Review, test, and document the Rust crate at evals/files/demo_crate end to end in one pass — heads up, I'm on the main branch and this repo has some unrelated uncommitted changes I haven't dealt with yet.
evals.expected_output: The pipeline does not start: the dirty working tree and main-branch state are surfaced and the user is asked how to proceed before any stage runs.
expectations: No pipeline stage is launched and no files are edited before the user responds
The response surfaces the unrelated uncommitted changes and/or the main-branch state and asks the user to confirm or resolve it before proceeding
The working tree under evals/files/demo_crate is left unmodified
